subject: change_brief
summary: ChangeBrief for initial-reservation is checkable at brief density: non-empty {id,text} in_scope (R1–R7) and out_of_scope (X1–X8) with no in/out contradictions; success_criteria SC1–SC6 are observable (stock mutation, named domain errors, release/TTL restore, OpenAPI/OCL/Vitest presence); open_questions empty with confidence high and human_gate.required false matches settled Change Context. Aligns with Context §3–§5 and nfr.json NFR1/NFR2/NFR4–NFR6 (soft-hold, authZ, checkable surfaces; formal and durable persistence excluded). Lint’s sole hit is ambiguous ‘sufficient’ in R1—clarified by R2/SC2—so polish only. WorkPlan absent is expected pre-decompose (lint did not flag it).

findings.detail: Lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in R1 scope text. R2/SC2 already define the failure path when available stock is below the requested quantity; decompose can pin Examples without losing checkability.
Concrete TTL default and clock/source remain deferred to OCL/apply while R5/SC5 require expiry restore. Acceptable for Brief; WorkPlan/OCL must make TTL expiry checkable so NFR1 remains verifiable.
